1.consolidated_definition: mús. Mezclar, probar. Incorporar sonidos grabados con cualquier tipo de soporte. Anglicismo adaptado, poco frecuente. Ademas de que ambos miembros han venido de una fuerte base b-boy (eventos y de batalla ya sea como b-boys, organizadores, espectadores, etc.) S.P.I. trae a la mesa un banquete de musica traída directamente, optando por samplear sonidos de artistas de Puerto Rico y de latinoamerica en vez de del funk, souly jazz que se utiliza comúnmente (MySpace.com, PR, consultado 16-10-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Musical term: To mix or test sounds. Incorporate recorded sounds with any type of medium. Adapted Anglicism, infrequently used.

Additionally, both members having come from a strong B-boy base (events and battles as B-boys, organizers, spectators, etc.) S.P.I. brings to the table a banquet of music brought directly, opting for sampling sounds from Puerto Rican and Latin American artists instead of funk or soulful jazz commonly used (MySpace.com, PR, consulted 16-10-08).

Musical term: To blend, experiment with sounds. Incorporate recorded sounds with any type of support. Anglicism adapted, relatively uncommon.

Furthermore, both members having come from a strong B-boy background (events and battles as B-boys, organizers, spectators, etc.) S.P.I. presents a feast of music brought directly, choosing to sample sounds from Puerto Rican and Latin American artists rather than the funk or soulful jazz typically used (MySpace.com, PR, consulted 16-10-08).
